name: NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500
description: New York Department of Financial Services Cybersecurity Requirements for Financial Services Companies. Establishes cybersecurity requirements for banks, insurance companies, and other financial services institutions regulated by DFS.

name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
description: International standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Provides a systematic approach to managing sensitive company information through risk management processes.

name: SOC 2 Type II
description: Service Organization Control 2 Type II report based on Trust Services Criteria. Evaluates security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy controls over a period of time.

name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
description: Framework for improving critical infrastructure cybersecurity. Provides a common taxonomy and mechanism for organizations to describe their current cybersecurity posture and target state.

name: PCI DSS 4.0
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard. Security standard for organizations that handle branded credit cards to increase controls around cardholder data and reduce credit card fraud.

name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
description: Framework to better manage risks to individuals, organizations, and society associated with artificial intelligence. Addresses AI risks and promotes trustworthy AI development and use.

name: GLBA Safeguards Rule
description: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act Safeguards Rule requires financial institutions to develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive security program to protect customer information.

name: HIPAA Security Rule
description: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act Security Rule establishes national standards to protect individuals' electronic personal health information (ePHI) that is created, received, used, or maintained by a covered entity.

name: GDPR
description: General Data Protection Regulation is a comprehensive data protection law in the EU that governs how organizations collect, process, store, and transfer personal data of EU residents.

name: CCPA/CPRA
description: California Consumer Privacy Act and California Privacy Rights Act give California residents rights regarding their personal information and impose obligations on businesses that collect personal data.

name: CIS Controls v8
description: Center for Internet Security Critical Security Controls are a prioritized set of actions to protect organizations and data from known cyber attack vectors.

name: FedRAMP
description: Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program provides a standardized approach to security assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring for cloud products and services used by federal agencies.

name: CMMC 2.0
description: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification is a unifying standard for implementing cybersecurity across the Defense Industrial Base (DIB) to protect controlled unclassified information (CUI).

name: SOX IT Controls
description: Sarbanes-Oxley Act IT General Controls (ITGCs) are controls that apply to all systems components, processes, and data for a given organization or IT environment.

name: FFIEC IT Examination Handbook
description: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council IT Examination Handbook provides guidance on IT risk management for financial institutions.

name: NIST 800-53 Rev 5
description: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations. Provides a catalog of security and privacy controls for federal information systems.

name: NIST 800-171 Rev 2
description: Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations. Security requirements for protecting CUI in nonfederal systems.

name: ISO 27701
description: Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) extension to ISO 27001. Provides guidance for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving a PIMS.

name: COBIT 2019
description: Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies is a framework for the governance and management of enterprise IT.

name: EU AI Act
description: European Union Artificial Intelligence Act establishes rules for AI systems based on their risk level, with strict requirements for high-risk AI applications.

name: DORA
description: Digital Operational Resilience Act is an EU regulation on digital operational resilience for the financial sector, covering ICT risk management, incident reporting, and third-party risk.

name: StateRAMP
description: State Risk and Authorization Management Program provides a standardized approach to security assessment and authorization for cloud products used by state and local governments.

name: HITRUST CSF
description: Health Information Trust Alliance Common Security Framework integrates and harmonizes requirements from existing standards and regulations into a single overarching security framework.

name: NERC CIP
description: North American Electric Reliability Corporation Critical Infrastructure Protection standards for the security of the Bulk Electric System.

name: IEC 62443
description: Industrial communication networks - IT security for networks and systems. Comprehensive framework for securing Industrial Automation and Control Systems (IACS).

name: CSA STAR
description: Cloud Security Alliance Security Trust Assurance and Risk program provides a cloud security assurance program through self-assessment, third-party audit, and continuous monitoring.

name: SWIFT Customer Security Programme
description: SWIFT Customer Security Programme helps financial institutions strengthen their defenses against cyber threats. Includes mandatory and advisory security controls.

name: NY SHIELD Act
description: New York Stop Hacks and Improve Electronic Data Security Act requires businesses to implement reasonable safeguards to protect private information of New York residents.

name: SEC Cybersecurity Rules
description: SEC rules requiring public companies to disclose material cybersecurity incidents and describe their cybersecurity risk management, strategy, and governance.

name: TISAX
description: Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange is an assessment and exchange mechanism for information security in the automotive industry.
